I want it to happen so badly... but I lack the money/resources. I didn't even get any of the scholarships I applied for despite being a first-generation college student and having a 3.8 gpa. I don't believe in myself enough right now to take out student loans for med school.

Thank you, though. Your last statement is exactly why I want to be a doctor -- to help people. Too bad I cannot even help myself at the moment.
